description: Structured eval definitions for the Data Exchange Dataset Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Data Exchange scenarios (S3 asset export with Lake Formation integration, auto-export EventBridge rule on new revision, API asset live access via Data Exchange gateway, entitlement-based cross-account sharing, unfinalized revision prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: S3 asset export with Lake Formation governed access
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — S3_SNAPSHOT export to subscriber bucket, Lake Formation registration, Data Catalog table creation, IAM role with s3:PutObject
eval_cases.prompt: Subscribe to Data Exchange data set ds-abc12345 (S3_SNAPSHOT type, CSV market data). Subscription sub-def67890 is ACTIVE. The latest revision r-ghi11122 is FINALIZED with 5 assets. Export to S3 bucket my-analytics-bucket in us-east-1. IAM role dx-export-role has s3:PutObject on the bucket. Integrate with Lake Formation: register the S3 location and create Data Catalog table market_data in database data_exchange_db. Tags: Environment=production, DataSource=market-data.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATA_EXCHANGE: ds-abc12345 (subscription: sub-def67890) → S3: my-analytics-bucket
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Subscription: sub-def67890 — ACTIVE
  [✓] Data set: ds-abc12345 — S3_SNAPSHOT (CSV files)
  [✓] Revision: r-ghi11122 — FINALIZED
  [✓] Assets: 5 assets of type S3_SNAPSHOT
  [✓] Destination S3 bucket: my-analytics-bucket — exists
  [✓] IAM role: dx-export-role with s3:PutObject on my-analytics-bucket — configured
  [✓] Lake Formation: S3 location registered, Data Catalog table market_data — configured
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws dataexchange get-data-set --data-set-id ds-abc12345 --region us-east-1
  aws dataexchange get-job --job-id <job-id> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Auto-export with EventBridge rule on new revision
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — EventBridge rule triggers Lambda on Data Update event, Lambda calls StartJob for EXPORT_ASSETS_TO_S3, auto-export flow noted
eval_cases.prompt: Set up auto-export for Data Exchange data set ds-auto123. Subscription is ACTIVE. When a new revision is published, an EventBridge rule should trigger Lambda function dx-auto-export to start an export job copying S3_SNAPSHOT assets to bucket my-auto-bucket in us-east-1. IAM role for Lambda has dataexchange:StartJob and s3:PutObject permissions. Tags: Environment=production, Pipeline=auto-export.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATA_EXCHANGE: ds-auto123 (subscription: ACTIVE) → S3: my-auto-bucket
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data set: ds-auto123 — S3_SNAPSHOT
  [✓] Auto-export: EventBridge rule on Data Update → Lambda dx-auto-export → StartJob
  [✓] Destination S3 bucket: my-auto-bucket — exists
  [✓] IAM role: dataexchange:StartJob + s3:PutObject — configured

eval_cases.name: API asset live access via Data Exchange gateway
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — API asset accessed live (NOT exported to S3), authentication via Data Exchange signing keys, rate-limiting noted
eval_cases.prompt: Access API asset from Data Exchange data set ds-api456. Subscription sub-api789 is ACTIVE. The latest revision r-api111 has an API asset (REST endpoint at https://api.provider.com/v1/marketdata). The API provides real-time market data. Authentication is via Data Exchange signing keys. Tags: Environment=production, AccessMode=live.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATA_EXCHANGE: ds-api456 (subscription: sub-api789) → API: https://api.provider.com/v1/marketdata
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Subscription: sub-api789 — ACTIVE
  [✓] Data set: ds-api456 — API asset
  [✓] API asset access: https://api.provider.com/v1/marketdata — live access via Data Exchange gateway
  [✓] Authentication: Data Exchange signing keys — configured

eval_cases.name: Cross-account data set sharing via entitlement
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — entitlement as the sharing mechanism (NOT IAM), target account cited, receiving account exports to their S3 bucket
eval_cases.prompt: Share Data Exchange data set ds-share789 with AWS account 999999999999 via entitlement. The data set is S3_SNAPSHOT type. Provider account is 123456789012 in us-east-1. After the entitlement is created, the receiving account should export to bucket their-dx-bucket. Tags: Environment=production, SharedWith=partner.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATA_EXCHANGE: ds-share789 (entitlement → account 999999999999)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data set: ds-share789 — S3_SNAPSHOT
  [✓] Entitlement: target account 999999999999 — entitled
  [✓] Receiving account export: their-dx-bucket

eval_cases.name: Export with unfinalized revision (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — latest revision r-draft999 is in DRAFT state; only FINALIZED revisions can be exported; export job will fail
eval_cases.prompt: Export assets from Data Exchange data set ds-broken456. Subscription sub-broken123 is ACTIVE. The latest revision r-draft999 is in DRAFT state (not finalized). Attempting to create an export job for this revision. Destination bucket is my-bucket in us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DATA_EXCHANGE: ds-broken456 (subscription: sub-broken123)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Revision: r-draft999 — DRAFT (must be FINALIZED before export; export jobs fail on unfinalized revisions)
